record.capability: Original byte string owners and MIME encoding detection for XML transport
gaps: Original internal OStringLiteral/OString consumed byte ownership, default/copy/adopt/move, stable pointer field/address, assignment, counted search and substring owners now use actual SAL C/template allocation and reference primitives. Shared Copy/newFromStr_WithLength/assign/newFromSubString instantiate native byte and original UTF16 roles; no replacement allocator/value/type provider is supplied. Original MIME lookup retains all40 exact VIP and184 ordered prefix aliases including duplicates, at most30 normalized ASCII alphanumerics, native equality/prefix order and DONTKNOW fallback. Direct source-table audit confirms exact ordered entries. CALC-362/WRITER237 records permissive alias suffix admission. New OString and whole byte C owner100 evidence is distinct from a retained failing whole4-owner profile; no counters/thresholds/exclusions change. Existing native SAL evidence stays limited to its recorded scopes. XMLFile2UTFConverter/InputSource/UNO parser transport, further OString conveniences, full model/filter/worker/DOCX/XLSX/UI remain pending. Physical ABI, compile-time evaluation, allocator exhaustion, pointer undefined behavior and native threads remain unverified. Existing file/autosave/recovery deviations are unchanged.
